newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AUSTRALIA SEMIS - Track the gyrations.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AUSTRALIA SEMIS - Track the gyrations.

text.p: *Long-dated semi bond yields generally tracked the gyrations of the Australian Treasury market over the course of the past week, leaving spreads between them little changed.
Long-dated semi-government bond yields generally tracked the gyrations of the Australian Treasury market over the course of the past week, leaving spreads between them little changed.
"There's not much of a story in the semis market for the moment. People are still looking to buy into them, but spreads look as if they have gone as far as they can go for now," one trader said.
Long-dated spreads have kept to fairly steady levels in the past month or so, although there has been more flexibilty at the short-end, which tended wider on the week.
